description.zh: 波次刷怪 + 升级构筑的竞技场生存游戏。角色自动攻击最近的敌人，击杀怪物获取经验，升级时三选一强化，撑过一波又一波越来越凶的怪物潮。自动保存最高分与最高波次。
description.en: Wave-based arena survival with roguelite upgrades. Auto-attack the nearest enemy, gain XP from kills, pick 1 of 3 upgrades on level-up, and survive ever-harsher monster waves. Best score & wave auto-saved.

controls.zh: WASD/方向键移动（自动攻击最近敌人）；升级时点击卡片或按 1/2/3 选择强化；Esc/P 暂停；触屏使用虚拟摇杆
controls.en: WASD/Arrows to move (auto-attacks the nearest enemy); click a card or press 1/2/3 to pick upgrades; Esc/P to pause; virtual joystick on touch devices
